scenes.text: Imagine you are standing in the middle of a scorching Mexican desert, but suddenly your hand radio goes completely silent, and your vintage compass begins spinning wildly out of control.
Welcome to the infamous Zone of Silence, a bizarre patch of land that behaves like a literal dead zone for all modern electromagnetic signals, leaving researchers completely baffled to this day.

The mystery intensified in 1970 when an advanced American military rocket inexplicably veered hundreds of miles off course, crashing directly into this empty wasteland as if dragged down by some powerful, invisible force.
While some believe the soil is packed with heavy meteorite debris that swallows radio waves, others swear it is an extraterrestrial portal, so comment if you would ever dare to camp here!
